decision_type: Read-only study and proposed campaign plan

question_or_problem: Improve qualified service inquiries without spending on an unverified draft
evidence_date_range: 2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30; account setup and creatives inspected 2026-10-02; live state not reverified 2026-10-03
evidence_summary: Selected historical data showed 332 Messaging conversations started at PHP36.93 campaign-level; the inspected static image ad showed 58 at PHP31.09 and the historical video ad 9 at PHP43.07. Rows had unequal delivery and unknown lead quality; figures do not establish a causal creative winner or job outcomes. Owner directs future ads to remain photo-only. Current live campaign state is unverified.
options_considered: Continue existing draft after separately approved corrections; one locally restricted Messenger inquiry campaign; website conversion optimization after verified events
recommendation: Conditional proposal: one owner-confirmed local Engagement-to-Messenger campaign, one ad set, two authentic static-photo variants with otherwise consistent setup; measure qualified inquiries and booked/completed jobs separately from Meta conversations. Prior PHP3,500/14-day proposal is illustrative only, not approved.
reason_or_hypothesis: Focus spend and learning in one serviceable area; optimize toward the real business outcome rather than conversation volume alone; align with photo-only preference; avoid web-event optimization while the visible PIANO dataset had no events.
expected_signal_and_review_date: If separately approved and launched: check delivery/destination and spend at 48 hours; review aggregate inquiry quality around day 7; assess full test around day 14 against an owner-agreed cost guardrail.
risks_or_guardrails: No live account state reverified 2026-10-03. Exact service, service area, staffed booking path, capacity, assets and all-in spend limit remain unknown. No draft changes or spend authorized. Do not reuse historical offer/claims without confirmation; do not declare a winner from small or unmatched samples.
confidence: Moderate strategic confidence; low confidence in predicted results
